column1: #mapping_set_description: GenomeInfoDb genomeMappingTbl.csv (inst/extdata/dataFiles/), used by mapGenomeBuilds() and genomeBuilds() to map Ensembl assembly names to UCSC genome builds. One record per Ensembl assembly name. The example is an excerpt (header plus all human and yeast rows).
